answer: Correlation slashing: every agent locks a 50 POA anchor bond. Each epoch, verifiers score answers, latency and funding paths into a fingerprint, like veins in marble. Agents whose veins match beyond chance share one reward slot; a confirmed cluster forfeits every bond. So 100 sybils cost 5,000 POA at risk to earn one agent's reward, a pure loss. Weakness: honest agents on one base model can look alike. Fix: a basalt set of hidden, per-agent randomized probes that independent minds answer differently, plus a bonded appeal.
